hooks.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -er '.cwd | select(type == "string" and length > 0)') || { echo "Invalid hook cwd" >&2; exit 1; }; cd -- "$cwd" || exit 1; [ -d node_modules ] || exit 0; out=$(npm test 2>&1) || { if printf '%s' "$input" | jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "npm test failed after one retry; stopping automatic retries:" >&2; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -60 >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "npm test failed; fix the failures before the one allowed retry:" >&2; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -60 >&2; exit 2; }
